Brun04.finding: The publisher identifies a separate 2005 erratum, volume 143 issue 2 page 237. Its effect on the 2004 article has not been established; the original citation remains unchanged.
Brun04.next_evidence: Read the erratum text for DOI 10.1016/j.jneumeth.2005.03.001 and record which bibliographic or substantive information it corrects. Scripted retrieval returned 403.

Kerb14.finding: Crossref supplies locator 11.IT.3.1, but the accessible publisher excerpt does not independently label that value as pagination. No locator was inferred from the DOI.
Kerb14.next_evidence: Original article or official citation export explicitly naming the locator; scripted publisher request returned 403.

WitmEtal96.finding: Academic Press is a historical imprint, distinct from current registry publisher Elsevier BV. The exact corporate-name rule intentionally does not merge them.
WitmEtal96.next_evidence: Original 1996 issue/article publisher statement or dated imprint authority; scripted publisher request returned 403.

GuptEtal12.finding: Nature Publishing Group cannot be certified by equating it with present registry name Springer Science and Business Media LLC.
GuptEtal12.next_evidence: Original 2012 publisher statement or dated imprint authority. The scripted request redirected to a host outside the collector allowlist.

KoenEtal07.finding: Article identity and 2007 coordinates agree, but the Nature Publishing Group imprint is not corroborated by present Springer registry branding.
KoenEtal07.next_evidence: Original 2007 publisher statement or dated imprint authority. No acquisition-based alias was added.

BretEtal02.finding: Nature Publishing Group and the current registry publisher are historically distinct labels.

Nico03.finding: The article metadata agrees apart from the historical Nature Publishing Group publisher field.
Nico03.next_evidence: Original 2003 publisher statement or dated imprint authority; current hosting does not resolve the field.

HamaEtal08.finding: Little, Brown, and Co is unsupported by the article's Wiley registry/landing page. That page mentions Little, Brown only inside a 1954 reference; it cannot establish this article's publisher.
HamaEtal08.next_evidence: The 2008 article or issue front matter naming the original Wiley entity/imprint. Retained as unresolved rather than guessing an exact replacement.

AherBeat81.finding: Changed the misused organization=Springer field to publisher=Plenum Press. The chapter page identifies the 1981 Plenum Press copyright, while its current citation block names Springer US. This historical distinction remains explicit.
AherBeat81.next_evidence: Original book title/verso page identifying the 1981 publisher, then a narrowly scoped historical-imprint verifier.

Cohe90.finding: The publisher page explicitly dates the issue August 1990, volume 81 issue 3 pages 287-297. Crossref also carries an online date in 2011. The new automated date parser is limited to Cambridge, so this remains unresolved in automation.
Cohe90.next_evidence: A machine-readable Wiley issue-date source with matching DOI/author/volume/pages; scripted retrieval returned 403.

WiggEtal99.finding: Crossref supplies October 1998 while PubMed supplies 1999 for volume 37 issue 1 pages 103-118. Neither date was selected solely by majority or by DOI digits.
WiggEtal99.next_evidence: Original issue cover/front matter or article PDF that settles the journal issue date. Publisher page retrieval was unavailable.
